name: Kuua
summary: Kuua is a war-scarred Discordian world under the iron rule of the Muramite Legion, fractured by planar rifts and temporal wounds.
description: Kuua, once the proud homeland of the Dranik peoples, has been conquered and reshaped by the Muramite Legion. Discord energy bleeds through vast scars in the land, spawning aberrations and warping time itself. The native Dranik civilization lies in ruins, surviving only in scattered enclaves and hidden refuges, while Riftseekers struggle to contain the planar damage.
